summary: The kernel-modules group is 306 files in two read-only ext4 images: vendor_dlkm_a (271 files, 262 modules) and odm_dlkm_a (35 files, 27 modules). The 289 .ko files are 64-bit little-endian AArch64 ELF relocatable objects, all built for kernel 5.10.205-01655-g5c5a360e9c21 (identical vermagic). Each image carries modules.alias, modules.dep, modules.load, modules.softdep, a build.prop, a NOTICE.xml.gz (empty licence list) and two empty fs_config lists; vendor_dlkm_a also carries modules.blocklist. fstab.eureka mounts the images at /vendor_dlkm and /odm_dlkm, and /vendor/lib/modules and /odm/lib/modules are symlinks into them. Loading is done by /vendor/bin/init.insmod.sh, which reads init.insmod.charger.cfg (charger class, 37 named modprobe entries) or init.insmod.cfg (boot, modprobe -b * against both modules.load files). init.anorak.rc additionally loads wlan and sched-walt directly with modprobe. Module families visible from modinfo and aliases: Qualcomm SoC platform drivers (clocks, interconnect, SMMU, GLINK/QRTR transports, KGSL graphics, MSM DRM, cfg80211/mac80211 WLAN stack, WCD/LPASS audio codecs, SPMI PMIC, UFS) in vendor_dlkm_a, and device drivers for Oculus/Meta peripherals (USB VDM, syncboss, sensors, regulators, charging dock) in odm_dlkm_a.

claims.label: verified
claims.claim: init.insmod.sh reads a config file of action|argument lines. For modprobe it builds the argument list from both modules.load files when the argument is '-b *', and it runs modprobe with both module directories as -d paths. It sets vendor.all.modules.ready and vendor.all.devices.ready at the end.
claims.evidence: Command: cat vendor_a/bin/init.insmod.sh (1533 bytes, run in eureka/mnt). Excerpt: 'case ${arg} in "-b *" | "-b") arg="-b $(cat /vendor_dlkm/lib/modules/modules.load /odm_dlkm/lib/modules/modules.load 2>/dev/null)" ;;' then 'modprobe -a -d /vendor_dlkm/lib/modules -d /odm_dlkm/lib/modules $arg ;;'. Final lines: 'setprop vendor.all.modules.ready 1' and 'setprop vendor.all.devices.ready 1'.
claims.reason: Script is 1533 bytes. The '-b *' case expands to the modules.load files of /vendor_dlkm and /odm_dlkm, modprobe -a runs with -d for both trees, and the last two lines are setprop vendor.all.modules.ready 1 and vendor.all.devices.ready 1. The script also has a '*' or empty-argument case that the claim does not mention; this does not contradict it.

init.insmod.sh (vendor_a/bin) and init.anorak.rc belong to other subsystems and were cited only for module-loading references.
